subject: Intro: short exec demo (VP/CIO/CTO) — recording preference & slot
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@solivus.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@solivus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T08:05:00-04:00
Subject: Intro: short exec demo (VP/CIO/CTO) — recording preference & slot

Hi Elaine and Mike,

Thanks for the time earlier — excited to pull together a short, focused demo for Solivus that highlights how Redwood Inference can reduce token costs and keep latency predictable for your production pipelines.

Quick ask: could you confirm whether VP/CIO/CTO attendance is possible? We typically run a 30-minute executive walkthrough + 10-minute Q&A, but we can compress to 20 minutes if your execs prefer. Also: would you like the session recorded? We can disable recording on request.

Proposed short windows (PT):
- Tue Aug 2: 9:00 — 9:30 AM PT
- Wed Aug 3: 10:00 — 10:30 AM PT

Attached: short-demo-agenda.pdf (2 slides), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (high-level next steps).

If those times work, I can send a calendar invite and an exec one-pager. If the CTO prefers a shorter technical chunk, we can split 12/8 minutes — whatever works.

Next step: confirm preferred window, who from Solivus will join (names/titles) and whether recording is allowed.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
priym.das@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elaine Park <elaine.park@solivus.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Turner <mike.turner@solivus.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T09:14:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Intro: short exec demo (VP/CIO/CTO) — recording preference & slot

Thanks, Priyom — appreciate the concise options.

Quick answers:
- Wed Aug 3 10:00 PT is our preference but we need to keep it tight to 20 minutes (execs have back-to-back).
- Recording: CTO prefers no recording for the live demo (security reasons). Please respect that.
- Internal attendees that should be on the invite: Mark Liu (CTO, mark.liu@solivus.com), Priya Shah (VP Eng, priya.shah@solivus.com), and myself (Elaine Park, Head of Platform Partnerships).

Additionally, our security team will want a quick SOC2/high-level security summary ahead of the meeting — I can loop them in separately (security@solivus.com). If you have a one-page SOC2 summary or list of controls, please attach it to your confirmation.

If you can make the agenda 12 minutes demo / 8 minutes exec Q&A that should work.

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Director of Strategic Partnerships, Solivus
elaine.park@solivus.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T09:30:00-04:00
Subject: Fwd: Intro: short exec demo (VP/CIO/CTO) — recording preference & slot

Soojin / Marissa — quick coordination:

Elaine confirmed Aug 3 at 10:00 PT but asked to keep the session to 20 minutes and the CTO requested no recording. Action items below:

- Soojin: can you lead the demo and focus on the two-minute value summary, 8-minute deep-dive on latency/cost tradeoffs, and be prepared for a 4-minute technical Q&A? Since recording is off, please capture the two demo clips we can reuse later (local screen recording offline) in case we need a snippet for internal follow-up.
- Marissa: please prepare an "exec one-pager" (attached: exec-one-pager.pdf draft) highlighting 3 metrics (expected token cost reduction, p95 latency, and fallback reliability). Keep to one slide for the execs.
- Priyom: please confirm the calendar invite and include the SOC2 one-pager (redwood_soc2_summary.pdf).

Note: Because time is tight, the recommended agenda is 12 min demo / 8 min exec Q&A. We'll need a hard cut at 20 minutes. I'll be on the call to introduce and handle commercial follow-ups.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@solivus.com>, Mike Turner <mike.turner@solivus.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-07-09T10:10:00-04:00
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Aug 3, 10:00—10:20 AM PT (Solivus exec demo) — no recording

Great — thanks Elaine and team. Calendar invite sent: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234-solivus-aug3-1000

Final details:
Agenda (20 min):
- 0:00–2:00 Intro & context (Karthik)
- 2:00–14:00 Focused demo (Soojin) — a short production example + cost/latency numbers
- 14:00–20:00 Exec Q&A (Elaine / Mark / Priya)

Attachments included: short-demo-agenda.pdf, exec-one-pager.pdf (Marissa draft), redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, mutual-action-plan.xlsx (for commercial next steps).

Recording: per request we will not record the meeting. If we need a follow-up artifact we will prepare a short 2–3 minute excerpt and share it separately with your permission.

If anything changes on your side (attendee swap or need to open the window to 25 min) please reply and we will adjust.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Priyom Das
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
